description: What your calls cost: every charge on this account over the last `hours` (default 24), newest first, each with what it was for, the model, the tokens it was worth, the tokens actually taken, and the dollar value at Switch retail; plus totals, the current token balance, and what a token is worth. Use this to itemize Seed Audio, Sync 3 lip-sync, generate_sound and every video or picture call. Free to call.

hours.description: How far back to look, in hours (1 to 720, default 24).

limit.description: How many charges at most (1 to 200, default 50).
